The '''Solusar family''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] family of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Its known members included [[Ranik Solusar]], [[Kam Solusar]], and his wife [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]].

==''Lightsider'' family tree==
The original creator of Kam Solusar, [[Tom Veitch]], intended to expand upon the Solusar Family through his unreleased novella, ''[[Lightsider (story)|Star Wars: Lightsider]]''. While the storyline was never officially released, and thus non-canon to ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'', two manuscripts of ''Star Wars: Lightsider'' were released in [[2023]] as online PDFs by [[Joseph Bongiorno]]<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref>; thus providing expanded information on the Solusar Family Tree.
